name: Silvio
source:
A bright boy working in the Cattleya Pharmacy. His good social graces and persuasive tongue attract many female customers to the shop. He has very good physical abilities and is very flexible. He also has a brave side to him by assisting the unreliable Gerda.

[From [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/?page=silvio]Official site[/url]]
